eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Millard, UT; at 4:41 PM on AUG 1, 2026 Effective until 4:41 PM AUG 2, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Millard/Sheriff: Kanosh South of 300 S. is in GO status. Significant danger; mandatory evacuation in effect. Leave now. Stay alert and watch local news and cell phone alerts. Confirm your plan with family and loved ones, and check on neighbors who may need help. Shelter located in Fillmore at Stake Center.
